body:
At snapshot 0ece2cf2c2745c3574ffb65dbabdfcadd7163c14, .github/workflows/security.yml runs github/codeql-action/analyze and its terminal gate observes only job outcomes. Analyze succeeds when analysis and upload succeed, even when SARIF contains findings. This is the same integration gap tracked in the JavaScript template #266 and Python template #122; it is not evidence of a vulnerability in this Rust template itself.

Reproducible downstream evidence: https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/actions/runs/40790641642 succeeded at dc30f00aefb2c1a89c64bf7e7fa78ef80a860fe7 while its JavaScript SARIF contained 50 findings. https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/pull/53 archives that SARIF; replaying it with `node js/scripts/check-codeql-results.mjs PATH_TO_REPORT_DIRECTORY` exits nonzero and reports 50 findings. A synthetic regression is one valid SARIF 2.1.0 CodeQL run containing one result: analyze/upload success must not imply a clean security gate.

Workaround: explicitly require the separate Code Scanning check in branch rules rather than relying only on the aggregate workflow.

Suggested fix: give analyze an explicit `output` directory; afterward run a dependency-free SARIF gate that rejects absent/malformed reports, unsuccessful invocations and unresolved findings in every file/run, including warning/note severities. Keep all queries and the normal upload. Preserve the SARIF artifact even after gate failure. For reviewed intentional APIs, scope any exception to rule, file, line and full source-file SHA256 with a reason and test reference rather than disabling a query.

Reusable implementation and regression tests: https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-52-966c0184cc29/js/scripts/check-codeql-results.mjs and https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-52-966c0184cc29/js/tests/ci-codeql-results.test.js. Tests cover missing/invalid reports, multiple files/runs, every severity, execution failure, changed exception digests and CLI exit status.

Official analyze input/output contract: https://github.com/github/codeql-action/blob/main/analyze/action.yml.
title: Security workflow can pass while CodeQL reports unresolved findings
